What You’ll Do

Eaton is seeking a Manager, Strategy & Corporate Development team in driving enterprise growth through rigorous financial analysis, valuation, and business case development. The role will support both organic and inorganic growth initiatives, including portfolio analysis, strategic planning, and deal evaluation, and will work closely with global SCD leadership team.

• Evaluate enterprise, business-unit, and peer performance through returns, capital allocation, and value creation analyses.
• Perform financial analyses that support strategic initiatives, organic growth, and M&A decisions, isolating the factors that drive or erode growth, profitability, and capital returns.
• Build and maintain valuation models, including DCF, trading comparables, sensitivity analysis, and scenario modeling.
• Develop clear, executive-ready business case presentations that translate analysis into strategic recommendations.
• Support portfolio strategy by evaluating resource allocation, value creation opportunities, and underperforming areas.
• Analyze end-markets, competitors, suppliers, and industry trends to support corporate strategy and deal screening.
• Partner closely with business unit leaders, finance, and corporate development stakeholders to support decision-making and transaction execution.
• Assist in preparing materials for leadership reviews, investment discussions, and strategic planning cycles.

Qualifications

• 8-10 years of relevant experience in investment banking, industrial M&A, corporate development, transaction advisory, or a similar finance-intensive role.
• MBA or equivalent finance-focused qualification preferred.

Skills

• Strong command of financial modeling, valuation, accounting, and corporate finance.
• CFA Level 3 cleared or equivalent.
• Demonstrated ability to prepare DCF models, valuation analyses, and investment-style business cases.
• Strong understanding of DuPont analysis, return on capital, and value creation frameworks.
• Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills, with strong attention to detail and model integrity.
• Ability to communicate complex financial insights clearly to senior stakeholders.
• Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, or enterprise environments preferred.
• Exposure to organic growth strategy, M&A, portfolio management, or enterprise capital allocation.
• Experience supporting board or executive-level presentations.
• Strong research capability and comfort working with public and market data.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Headquarters: Victoria, British Columbia, Canada
 
URL: https://geoproapp.com

The opportunity 

I'm looking for an experienced operator to take ownership of a portfolio of three established Shopify apps with a combined ARR of approximately $1.87M.

The portfolio includes:

• Geo:Pro: Geolocation-based storefront personalization

• TrackiPal: PayPal tracking automation for Shopify merchants

• Easy Lockdown: Content and storefront access control

Together, these are profitable, well-established products with engaged customer bases. They're not hypergrowth startups, but well-run businesses with clear opportunities to improve the product experience, strengthen operations and continue growing over time.

As the portfolio has grown, it's reached the point where I need an experienced operator to lead the day-to-day, keep the business running smoothly and turn strategy into execution. 

The role is fully remote, async-friendly and suited to someone who enjoys ownership, autonomy and building well-run businesses.

What you'd own 

• Team coordination and delivery: Run the day-to-day by coordinating the developer and tester through the full delivery cycle - from spec → build → ship → measure - keeping everyone aligned across time zones and hiring additional contractors as needed.

• Roadmap and prioritization: We'll set the roadmap together. I'll be closely involved at first, and over time this becomes increasingly your call. Turn Amplitude data, review themes and support signals into a prioritized backlog in Linear, and write clear tickets for the developer.

• Metrics and experimentation: Own the analytics story. Understand what moved, what didn't and what to try next. Design experiments and report on impact. 

• Quality and documentation: Continually raise the bar on user experience through better documentation, smoother onboarding, fewer rough edges.

• Platform stewardship: Stay ahead of Shopify API changes, manage App Store compliance reviews and lead our annual Built for Shopify review to retain BFS status.

• Support oversight and escalations: Our support agency handles tier-1 tickets. You're the escalation point for product and engineering issues and own the agency relationship, ensuring response times, ticket quality and the merchant experience meet the bar. 

• Shopify App Store Paid Ads: Oversee existing paid advertising campaigns, working with our marketing contractor to ensure everything runs smoothly. We'll set the marketing budget together each quarter, and you'll manage it.

• Shopify App Store rankings: Monitor Shopify App Store rankings across the portfolio, identify opportunities to improve rankings and respond quickly when rankings decline.     

What you don't have to do 

• Write code (there's a developer for that) 

• Do QA (there's a tester for that)

• Handle routine support tickets (an agency handles that)

• Respond to reviews (a contractor handles that)

• Fundraise, hire executives, sit in stakeholder meetings or manage political overhead - none of that exists here 

Growth areas we've already identified 

• Easy Lockdown: Shift to usage-based pricing 

• Geo:Pro + Easy Lockdown: Onboarding and activation optimization 

• Geo:Pro + Easy Lockdown: Feature gaps that address missing customer use cases

• All three apps: Lift review ratings to improve organic App Store rankings

You're not walking into a blank page - there's already a clear direction, but plenty of room to test your own ideas.

What you'll be walking into

• Small, remote team: You'll be coordinating a small team of contractors working across different time zones, so communication and keeping work moving are a big part of the role. 

• Established products: The apps are profitable and well established, but some of the codebases are older and occasionally require pragmatic workarounds rather than perfect solutions. 

• Data-driven decisions: Our analytics stack is solid (Amplitude, BigQuery, Shopify Partners)  - SQL fluency, or comfort writing it with AI help, is required. 

How we'll work together

• Founder involvement: I've run these apps alongside another business and know them inside out. I'll stay focused on product direction, strategy, quarterly planning and major decisions while you run the day-to-day.

• Working rhythm: We'll meet weekly at first while we build context and alignment, then move to monthly strategy check-ins and quarterly planning sessions. Beyond that, you'll have the autonomy to run with it.

Who you are 

• Strong operator: You've successfully run product or delivery for a small SaaS team. Background isn't important - results are.

• Technically fluent: You can write clear product specs, understand trade-offs and weigh development estimates without needing to review code.

• Organized and proactive: You enjoy coordinating people, removing blockers and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Data-driven: You use Amplitude, SQL and customer feedback to inform decisions.

• Self-directed: You're comfortable working asynchronously, managing your own priorities and taking ownership without constant direction.

• Bonus: Experience in the Shopify ecosystem, App Store Optimization (ASO), paid acquisition or SaaS growth. 

Where this could go 

This isn't a role with a fixed ceiling. As you build context, take on more responsibility and the portfolio grows, there's scope for the role to grow too. Exactly what that looks like will depend on the business and the impact you have, but the door is genuinely open.

Role details 

• Time: Part-time, approximately 15-25 hours per week

• Compensation: US$65-$85/hour, depending on experience

• Employment: Contractor or employee - whichever works best for you

• Location: Fully remote, async-friendly, any timezone

• Start: As soon as you're available

How to apply 

If this sounds like a role you'd enjoy, send me a 3-5 minute Loom walking me through how you'd approach your first 90 days. Assume you've had one week to get oriented - what would you focus on first, what would you want to understand, and how would you decide what to work on?

Email your Loom to: apply@geoproapp.com 

I'll personally review every application. If your Loom is a strong fit, I'll invite you to a short introductory interview. If that goes well, we'll schedule a final, more in-depth interview before making an offer.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/geopro-labs-inc-head-of-operations-shopify-app-portfolio

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

Stripe has unique operational problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with as a result of "growing the GDP of the Internet." Stripes leverage understanding of our products, the financial industry and money movement, and our processes to support both internal and external users. Doing so requires us to invest significant resources into building this experience ourselves.

What you'll do

Responsibilities

  • Develop a foundational understanding of our products, services, and features to assist customers effectively
  • Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries via email, providing accurate information and resources
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot customer issues under the guidance of senior team members, escalating complex issues to appropriate departments
  • Follow up with customers to ensure their issues are fully resolved and they are satisfied with the service provided
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of customer interactions, issues, and resolutions using internal tools
  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and continuous learning initiatives to enhance skills and knowledge
  • Engage in comprehensive training programs, seeking feedback and actively working on improving performance and developing professional skills

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems.
  • You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • You excel in analytical thinking, open-ended research, and problem solving.
  • You enjoy learning about technical products and processes. You are an organized self-starter with a passion for finding solutions.
  • You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done.
  • You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
  • You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
  • You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.
  • You are a current student or have recently graduated in 2026.

This is a 6-month Apprenticeship Intern Program, starting in Jan 2027 and run in accordance with the Apprentices Act 1961.
